reviewNotes: HOLD — BSMU publishes a current 2026/27 English General Medicine fee (US$6,300 annually), a six-year duration and a foreign-applicant interview route that tests instruction language, chemistry and biology. The World Directory lists the six-year English MD programme and records ECFMG eligibility subject to its conditions. A publishable commercial record is still incomplete: the official sources reviewed do not give a current international application deadline/intake calendar, current residence/accommodation cost, a complete current fee schedule beyond tuition, or a country-level visa and post-arrival cost source. No fee estimate has been inferred.

sources.label: BSMU official annual fees 2026/2027
sources.notes: Lists English General Medicine at US$6,300 for 2026/27, with a US$3,150 first advance payment by September 16, 2026.

sources.label: BSMU rules and procedure for admission
sources.notes: Foreign citizens apply on a fee basis after obtaining an invitation; first-year admission is competitive and includes an interview in the instruction language, chemistry and biology. It lists passport, secondary-school certificate, health/HIV documentation, photographs and other submission requirements.

sources.label: BSMU official English homepage
sources.notes: Confirms Minsk location, nine faculties/three institutes and teaching in Russian and English; the medical faculty for international students is listed.

sources.label: World Directory of Medical Schools — BSMU
sources.notes: Lists Medicine in English (six-year MD), instruction in English, international-student restriction for that programme, and ECFMG-certification eligibility subject to directory conditions.
